what: Full research on the four multi-day routes the accuracy check found off (Goode NE Buttress, Dark Peak, Daniel, Shasta Avalanche Gulch). Each leg sourced separately; applied with apply-trip-time-consistency.mjs.

routes.why: Approach leg said 6 hr while day 1 and its section said 8, and 6+9+15 did not make 32. Reports put trailhead-to-high-camp at 8-9 hr (6.5-11), camp-to-summit at 8-9 hr (7-12; course table 9-12), and summit-to-car at 13-15 hr (10-18) usually over two days; the row now reads 8.5 + 9 + 14 = 31.5 everywhere.

routes.why: The summit leg (9 hr) held only the climb up while descent (10.25) folded the return to camp into the hike-out day, and no day had hours. Reports put camp to summit at about 7-9 hr and back to camp at about 5-7 hr (a 14-15 hr summit day across four accounts), with about 3.5-4 hr each way on the trail; the row now reads 4 + 14 + 3.5 = 21.5 hr over the three days.

routes.why: The row put 15 hr on the summit-and-walk-out day (8.5 hr camp to summit) and 4.5 hr on the walk in, a 19.5 hr total. Two reports of this exact glacier line give 4.5 hr camp to summit; reports and a route profile give about 2.5 hr back to camp, about 3 hr camp to car and about 3.5 hr car to camp with an overnight pack, so the trip is about 14 hr moving (3.5 + 10.5), in line with 11-13 hr single-day ascents.

evidence.says: Daniel Glacier route from Peggy's Pond: ~6.5 hr trailhead to the pond in heavy early-season snow; 4.5 hr camp to West summit; 2.5 hr summit back to camp (down the SE ridge); 4 hr camp to car with packs.
Daniel Glacier crossing: left camp just after 3 am, West summit 7:30 am (~4.5 hr one way); back at trailhead around 3-4 pm after breaking camp and resting.
Route profile (Lynch Glacier, the longer neighbouring route from the same camp): 2.5-4 hr trailhead to camp, 5-7 hr camp to summit, 2-3 hr summit to camp, 3-4 hr camp to trailhead.
SE Ridge from Peggy's Pond: hike in about 4 hr; 5-6 hr up and 4 down on climb day.
Lynch Glacier from Peggy's Pond: left camp 4:30 am, summit 10:30 (6 hr), back at camp 1 pm (2 hr), left 2 pm, trailhead 4:45 pm (2.75 hr camp to car).
Climber log: 5.5 hr camp to camp from Peggy's Pond (SE side scramble); a fast party 3h15 up, 2h25 down; one party 7:30 start and above Peggy's Pond by 10:15 (2.75 hr, light pack).
Single-day ascents from the same side: summit in ~6 hr and ~11 hr car to car; another just short of 12 hr car to car.

routes.why: The row's total (12 hr) matched its own legs but the day plan did not (day 1 at 5 hr, summit day blank), and the legs ran short of reported times. Independent parties report about 3.25-5 hr to Helen Lake (middle ~4.5), 3.75-6.5 hr from Helen Lake to the top (middle ~5.5; guided parties 8-9), about 2-4 hr back to camp and about 2 hr camp to car, so the summit day that walks out is about 10 hr and the trip 14.5 hr of moving time.
